exposure: hospital of delivery (ElShatby University Maternity Hospital vs. Dar Ismail Public Hospital)
cohort: 280 females who gave birth between January and April 2014 at either ElShatby University Maternity Hospital (n=130) or Dar Ismail Public Hospital (n=150) in Alexandria, Egypt.
finding: The study found higher rates of cesarean section at ElShatby University Hospital (61.5%) compared to Dar Ismail Hospital (41.3%), and eclampsia was the most common cause of maternal mortality (75% of deaths).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was significantly higher among women delivered at ElShatby University Hospital compared to Dar Ismail Hospital (61.5% versus 41.3%).
